reviews.title: BEWARE: The $1 "Free" Reading is a Deceptive Subscription Trap
reviews.text:
I am writing this to warn others about the predatory billing practices of this app. I signed up through an ad offering a "free" reading for a $1 access fee. Not only did I never receive the reading, but the app also used my payment information to enroll me in a hidden subscription without my clear consent.
Weeks later, I was hit with a $42.99 charge for a service I never used and never agreed to. When I contacted their support team, I was given the runaround for three weeks. They initially claimed PayPal was holding the refund, only to eventually refuse the refund entirely with a boilerplate email.
The red flags:
• Bait-and-Switch: Promising a service for $1 and then charging nearly $43 weeks later.
• Zero Value: They took the money but never delivered the initial product (the reading).
• Dishonest Support: Providing conflicting information about refund status to stall for time.
This is a textbook "subscription trap." If you are considering downloading this app for a cheap reading, save your dollar and your time. I will be escalating this with my bank and reporting this to the appropriate consumer protection agencies. 

******************
Avoid at all costs.
******************
SCAM ALLERT.

Please reach out to us at support-appstore@asknebula.com with a few details about your account or the transaction, and our team will be glad to look into it and assist you further. Respectfully, Nebula Team 🔮
